subject: Finexa - Security evidence & next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Gupta <sanjay.gupta@finexa.com>, Priya Mehra <priya.mehra@finexa.com>, Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-28T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Finexa - Security evidence & next steps

Hi Sanjay / Priya / Rachel,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about Finexa's timeline and decision criteria. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Decision criteria: security assurances (SOC 2 + pen test), predictable latency under 300ms p95, cost per 1M tokens target, and vendor contractual terms (DPA + standard SOW).
- Stakeholders you mentioned: Rachel (security), Priya (procurement), Sanjay (owner / product).
- Action items we agreed: Redwood to share SOC 2 report + pen-test summary, sample audit logs and data retention answers. Finexa to confirm procurement timeline and economic buyer (if not Sanjay).

I'll loop in Marissa (solutions/SE) to provide the security artifacts and a short note on how we handle audit logs/retention. Please confirm if anyone else should be on the thread.

Proposed next step: 30-minute follow-up early next week to review artifacts and confirm procurement steps. What windows work for you?

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Ben — quick clarification from procurement side: 

- Procurement needs an expected lead time for SOC 2 documentation (do you have the latest cert date?) and an estimated time to finalize the DPA/SOW (we usually run a 3-4 week review).
- Can you confirm who the economic buyer will be in contracting? Sanjay is the product owner but procurement needs a named executive for spend approvals.

If you can send the artifacts today we can start internal intake and loop legal. Looking at calendars — we can do a follow-up Tues/Wed next week.

Thanks,
Priya Mehra
Procurement Manager | Finexa

Date: 2026-06-29T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finexa - Security evidence & next steps

Hi all,

Attaching the artifacts we referenced on the call: 
- SOC2-report-2025.pdf (stub) — SOC 2 Type II, reporting period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31.
- pen-test-summary-2026.pdf (stub) — third-party summary, high/medium/low findings redacted; full report available under NDA.

Notes: 
- We rotate pen tests annually; the 2026 engagement was completed May 2026.
- Audit logs: we capture request/response metadata, timestamps, and model version identifiers; sample CSV is available on request.
- Data retention: default 30 days for request metadata; customers can configure retention policies for enterprise/private deployments (can extend per contract).

Action for Finexa: please confirm who from security/legal should receive the full pen test and whether an NDA is required. If you want the full pen test report, we'll start the NDA flow (we can push via DocuSign).

Attachments: SOC2-report-2025.pdf (stub), pen-test-summary-2026.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Thanks Marissa — received the SOC2 and pen test summary. A couple of follow-ups from our side as we map stakeholders and the procurement flow: 

- Stakeholder map (please add if I missed anyone):
  - Sanjay Gupta — Product Lead (owner)
  - Rachel Lee — Security (evaluate SOC2 + pen tests)
  - Priya Mehra — Procurement (contracting timeline)
  - Mitesh Patel — Legal (will own DPA review)
  - Anika Shah — Engineering (integration point)

- Procurement timeline: We aim to complete vendor selection by July 20. Procurement/legal review will take ~3 weeks once they have artifacts.
- Requests: 
  1) Can you provide a short one-page summary on how Redwood stores/rotates keys and options for KMS/HSM?
  2) Sample audit logs (CSV) with redacted PII — to validate retention and fields captured.
  3) Confirmation on data-at-rest encryption and whether customer-managed keys are supported in Private deployments.

If you can get items 1–3 to us by Thursday (7/2) we'll schedule a technical review with Anika and Rachel the following week.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Director, Product | Finexa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Appreciate the clear stakeholder map and timeline, Sanjay. Quick update / delivery plan from our side: 

- Marissa attaching the sample audit logs CSV and a one-page KMS/HSM summary in this thread (see attachment).
- Confirmed: Redwood supports data-at-rest encryption across all deployment modes; customer-managed keys (KMS) supported in Private and Dedicated options — we'll include the KMS integration checklist for your engineering team.
- We can commit to delivering items 1–3 by EOD 2026-07-02.

Next steps: 
- I'll work with Priya to align on contracting cadence (expect 3–4 week legal review) and include Neha (billing/finance) if needed.
- Proposed technical review with Anika & Rachel: week of July 6. I'll propose slots once you confirm availability.

Attachments: audit-logs-sample.csv (stub), kms-hsm-onepager.pdf (stub)

Best,
